prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high-endurance athlete requiring 3000+ calories with carbohydrate loading for sustained energy

solution_criteria: Meal plan provides approximately 3000+ total calories across all meals
Carbohydrates comprise 55-65% of total calories to support endurance performance
Includes 4-5 eating occasions (breakfast, snacks, lunch, dinner, post-workout) spaced appropriately for sustained energy
All meals and quantities are realistic and practical for a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and sustained energy

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and increase strength for weightlifting competition in 8 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly one full day with 4-5 meals
Includes pre-workout and post-workout nutrition timed appropriately around training
Provides minimum 1.7g protein per kg bodyweight (144g+ total daily protein from vegetarian sources)
Balanced macronutrients supporting muscle gain with caloric intake appropriate for strength athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) requiring balanced macros with high protein intake and specific pre/post-workout nutrition timing

prompt_inputs.goal: High-performance training for competitive swimming with energy optimization for morning and evening pool sessions
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Severe nut allergy (including peanuts and tree nuts)

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers 3 meals and 2-3 snacks suitable for a 78 kg swimmer with ~3000-3500 daily caloric needs
All meals and snacks are nut-free and safe for severe nut allergy
Includes portable, easily digestible options timing around training sessions (pre/post-workout nutrition)
Plan is presented in compact, concise format covering one complete day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (swimmer) with dietary restrictions (nut allergy) requiring portable, easily digestible meals for training sessions
